lines.speaker: B
lines.meaning: I am fine, thank you. And you?

lines.speaker: A
lines.meaning: Nice to meet you. What is your name?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Me llamo Ravi. Soy de Chennai.
lines.say: me YAH-mo RAH-vee. soy de CHEN-nay.
lines.meaning: My name is Ravi. I am from Chennai.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Buenos días, Ravi. Siéntate, por favor.
lines.say: BWE-nos DEE-as, RAH-vee. SYEN-ta-te, por fa-VOR.
lines.meaning: Good morning, Ravi. Please sit down.
